title: World Commerce Corporation / Maynard Corporation international cabal

tellings.quote: He places that in the World Commerce Corporation, which is this Caribbean constellation of shell sort of companies.

plain: This theory describes an international network operating through the World Commerce Corporation and the Maynard Corporation, which Michels calls "this Caribbean constellation of shell sort of companies". Michels lays it out while discussing claims by Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon employee turned whistleblower, who places the network in that corporation. Michels connects it to Otto Scorzani, to the researcher Jason Simosa and to Sekret Machines, a book series by Tom DeLonge, which would make the network a private, offshore power behind the secrets they describe.
